name: Arkansas
standard: Legacy Section 508 (36 C.F.R. 1194.21 and 1194.22 as of 2019-01-01), nonvisual access

laws.cite: Ark. Code Ann. § 25-26-201 et seq. (Act 1227 of 1999, amended by Act 308 of 2013)
laws.summary: Technology bought with state funds must give blind and visually impaired users equivalent access.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

applies_to: The state and state-assisted organizations: colleges, nonprofits, political subdivisions, school systems and others funded in whole or part by the state.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Equivalent visual and nonvisual access for blind and visually impaired users
Written justification if an agency buys a product that does not best meet the standards
Reasonable accommodation when equivalent access is not available
mobile: not addressed — the statute predates mobile apps.
procurement: Vendors must submit a VPAT against 36 C.F.R. 1194.21/1194.22 and warrant nonvisual access; agencies may not claim no product is available.
enforcement: No enforcement mechanism found in the texts read.
notes: Covers blindness and visual impairment only. The standard is the pre-2017 Section 508 rules; no WCAG version is set by state law. Act 308 of 2013 text was not opened (it was read only through the procurement clause). No central state accessibility office page was found. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
